pr_title: Allow os.name and os.arch to be set when cross-compiling

issue_context.title: [native image] os.name and os.arch System properties for target

review_comments: This is quite loosely coupled (i.e. allows to lie about `os.name` and  `os.arch` independent from actually doing cross-compilation). Is this a temporary solution? (I.e. the setting of `os.name` and  `os.arch` should be driven by actual cross-compilation options.)
svm.targetArch is already used for actual cross-compilation, https://github.com/oracle/graal/blob/master/substratevm/src/com.oracle.objectfile/src/com/oracle/objectfile/macho/MachOObjectFile.java#L83

Hmm, maybe I miss something but that seems to just tweak how relocations are generated in the output object file. Would it make more sense to derive `os.arch` from the `org.graalvm.nativeimage.Platform` we are building for?
